newsitem.title: JAPAN: GOLF-WATTS SHARES TWO-SHOT LEAD WITH TESHIMA.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-WATTS SHARES TWO-SHOT LEAD WITH TESHIMA.

text.p: American Brian Watts shared a two-shot lead with overnight Japanese leader Taichi Teshima on Friday when he shot a 65 in the second round of the $1 million Chunichi Crowns tournament.
Watts, vying for his ninth career tour victory in Japan, carded six birdies and dropped one bogey for a two-round total of eight-under 132.
Teshima, who has not won any tournament in the past five years, dropped three shots on the front nine before fighting his way back for an even-par round.

World number one Greg Norman recorded a bogey-free 68 for a two-round total of 134 to trail two strokes behind the co-leaders, along with local favourite Masashi Ozaki, Kiyoshi Murota and Kazuhiro Takami.
Japan's Nobumitsu Yuhara had the day's best score of 64 to tie for seventh at five-under 135 with five other Japanese players.
